facts.fact: Stellarix Senegal, part of Axian, operates a data centre at Diamniadio offering colocation, cloud, connectivity and cybersecurity to outside customers, including banks and financial institutions.
Stellarix Senegal's managing director states its Diamniadio data centre is Tier 3 (operator's statement, no certification named).

note: Statement dated by the APS report of 27 Oct 2025.
